reasons.plausibility: Al has very limited solubility in BCC refractory metals and tends to form intermetallics, making a single-phase BCC solid solution with 20–40 at.% Al highly unlikely and contradicting known phase formation rules in HEAs.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and quantitative, with specific compositions, processing, measurements, and rejection criteria (density reduction <5% or strength drop >10%).
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the core trade-off but proposes a chemically implausible route, so it would misdirect experimental effort rather than guide a researcher toward a viable solution.
